headlines.headline: PORTAL ERA SETTLES AS NBA DRAFT LOOMS JUNE 23-24
headlines.detail: With the transfer window closed and the NBA withdrawal deadline past, all of ESPN's top 100 transfers have committed. Defending champ Michigan won its title with an all-transfer starting five, and the draft tips off June 23 in Brooklyn.

headlines.headline: KNICKS CROWNED CHAMPS, BRUNSON FINALS MVP; DRAFT NEXT
headlines.detail: New York won its first title since 1973, beating the Spurs in five. Jalen Brunson was the unanimous Finals MVP at 32.6 points per game. Attention turns to the June 23-24 draft, with a possible Giannis trade seen as the offseason's first domino.

headlines.headline: OFFSEASON QUIETS AS MINICAMPS WRAP, ROSTERS SET
headlines.detail: Mandatory minicamps have concluded and teams are off until late-July training camps. The free-agent pool still holds useful veterans, but most clubs have set rosters after an active March headlined by moves like Kyler Murray to Minnesota.

headlines.headline: CAM COLEMAN HEADLINES PORTAL AS RECRUITING RAMPS UP
headlines.detail: Auburn's Cam Coleman, ranked the top transfer prospect by 247Sports and Rivals, entered the portal as the marquee available name. June 15 opened direct coach contact with 2028 recruits, accelerating the win-now portal cycle.
